name: ELLIOT'S SECRET STASH
description:
Free stuff sounds harmless.

But sometimes, what looks like a useful download can contain something far more sinister — hidden in plain sight and stored without your knowledge.
An artifact associated with Elliot has been recovered. Your task is to investigate it and uncover the secret hidden inside.

🎯 Mission
Analyze the provided artifact and recover the hidden message.
The challenge uses the traditional flag{} format.

📁 Evidence
Investigate the provided challenge artifact.

🛠️ Suggested Tools
strings
file
exiftool
Binwalk
Steganography analysis tools

🚩 Flag Format
Submit the recovered flag using the format:
pcgCTF{theflaghere}
